stages.title: Fix the known-spawn/no-record gap
notes: A record-less stop is separated into empty-unstarted, known-birth and complete-record states; "no managed instance" is never read as "the spawned daemon stopped".

stages.title: Independent birth and liveness verification
notes: Before the record exists the birth pid/start/uid/argv/roots and the discovered child set are verified; a live birth or unknown child keeps clean=false.

stages.title: Release and unknown material handling
notes: releaseRoot accepts only a proven, self-owned exit; a missing record or default value can no longer absorb an unknown.

stages.title: First result: complete startup-phase tool
notes: Fourteen pure controls cover own, wrong start, sibling, foreign child, mixed unknown, start window, refused stop, idempotence, birth root, child scope, no-record birth/exit/reuse and package STOPPED with no record.

stages.title: Early alignment to the accurate target
notes: The subject is D 1ba0032 (sour ce/build/schema/tar/bytes read from its own manifest); ce64 stays a historical scope and the successor is not inferred from a checkout.

stages.title: Actual template preview in main
notes: The recipe preview route is absent from the frozen 1ba bytes and recorded as an exact capability difference; main source already serves it.

stages.title: Apply and revalidation before explicit create
notes: An installed apply/create claim needs a successor package; no route or field is fabricated for 1ba.

stages.title: Second result: current package template loop
notes: The template loop is reported as NOT_REACHED for these bytes with the exact missing route, not as a passing J/F unit test.

stages.title: Actual statistics entry and 7/30 days
notes: GET /v1/insights is exercised on 1ba: schema, 7/30 windows, scope, coverage, layers and auth/duplicate/invalid-day/timezone negatives.

stages.title: Context-use and source UI

stages.title: F identity and two-project daily flow
notes: The installed selector, four navigations, draft and identity isolation are browser-verified on the frozen bundle; stale responses are not accepted.

stages.title: Third result: visible same-package chain
notes: Template, statistics, context, source and UI results are reported with HTTP/actions/screenshots and exact remaining component differences.

stages.title: New package function mode/start/stop
notes: On 1ba the packaged launcher stops both a normal and a restored discussion-only instance by itself; detection and function are still separate cases.

stages.title: Two formats and recovery data
notes: v1/v2 snapshots, artifact closure, unknown-table boundary and the target-content gap are kept with their own evidence.

stages.title: Multi-root reuse and upgrade
notes: Same-install multi-state reuse, wrong root/selection/port refusals and baseline upgrade/rollback keep exit/status/pointer/operation/data.

stages.title: Fourth result: ordinary and functional on the current tar
notes: Function stop, two-format recovery, multi-root upgrade and reopen are reported for the exact 1ba bytes; native/private/target/value stay separate.

stages.title: Bounded new-risk observation
notes: Only new risks are re-verified within a deadline; the old 600/1800 fixtures are not rerun or advertised as a product soak.

stages.title: G/H/I/J raw inputs
notes: Each input is re-derived from source/tuple/hash/time/layer; no summary becomes a grant or release verdict.

stages.title: Support and colleague guide
notes: Packaged support output stays 0600, non-overwriting and credential-free; the guide matches the real preview/create and start/stop entries.

stages.title: Fifth result: daily trial and observation handoff
notes: Short availability, raw observation, support and explicit not-reached items are delivered with ordinary and functional results separated.

stages.title: Complete real positives and failure attribution
notes: Every case binds the 1ba subject and its own evidence; the ce64 functional failure stays historical and is not relabelled.

stages.title: Layered required and compatibility
notes: ordinary/functional/template/context/insights/recovery/native keep separate verdicts; full-product still refuses without native.

stages.title: Evidence and version facts
notes: Usable paths, mode limits and unadmitted capabilities are stated with source/tuple/hash/time/exit indexes.
